make it green before finishing.

Reject creating an owner whose telephone number is already used by any other owner. Respond with 409.

agent.result_text:
The full suite is green: **259 tests, 0 failures, 0 errors**.

## Summary

The requirement was to reject creating an owner whose telephone number is already used by any other owner, responding with 409. The new spec test (`Cp03Tests`) codifies this: telephone must be unique across **all** owners, regardless of name.

The existing `CheckDuplicateOwner` function only rejected on a *last name + telephone* match (via `findByLastName`), so a duplicate telephone under a different name would slip through. I broadened it:

- **`CheckDuplicateOwner.java`** — now iterates `ownerRepository.findAll()` and throws `DuplicateOwnerException` whenever any existing owner has the same telephone. This runs before `SaveOwner` in the `POST /api/owners` pipeline, and the exception maps to 409 Conflict via the existing `DuplicateOwnerExceptionHandler`.
- **`DuplicateOwnerException.java`** — updated the Javadoc to reflect the telephone-only rule.

This still covers the earlier checkpoints (byte-identical and same-last-name+telephone both share a telephone, so they remain 409), while correctly allowing owners with distinct telephones. No YAML wiring changes were needed since the `checkDuplicate` step was already in place.
